integrity: The stated theorem has an elementary infinite-domain proof; independent small-grid exact checks are supplemental, not a proof of the general theorem. No independent scholarly validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The formula covers maximal lattice-point affine sections of dilated integral cubes only; it does not prove the eventual quasipolynomial conjecture for arbitrary lattice polytopes. Earlier authors established the maximum cardinality. Historical priority of the new equality classification and exact counting formula remains provisional.
title: Maximal lattice sections of integer cubes: all ranks and a Stirling-number count
